page.layout: Two printed pages on the scan. Left page: blank, with only a library stamp and handwriting, which are not transcribed. Right page: the edge of a title page, cut off at the right side of the scan, with a decorated initial at the lower left of its text block.
page.notes: The left page carries only an oval library stamp (Ex Bibliotheca ...), which is not transcribed, and handwritten ink marks (a name and a signature-like scrawl), which are not transcribed. The right page is cropped at the right edge of the scan, so each line is shown only as far as it is visible. Lines marked with a short fragment are truncated, not complete words. The large letters "FR" and "OR" are part of a larger display word whose remaining letters are cut off. The decorated initial at the left of the lower lines is not a letter that can be read. The text is too incomplete to be read with certainty, so no word is supplied beyond what is visible.
